Refs #1904

## Cause

I bisected `38595772d..0e6777f81` on the Linux build host with the installed server-engine wheel. The first bad commit is `75a8168d3` (#1837, "omit consumed terminal triggers from model history"). Its parent `f7bec48a9` passes `test_hive_beebou_choice_card.py` 18/18. `75a8168d3` and `0e6777f81` fail `test_a_result_relayed_during_the_next_turn_is_reported_in_its_view`.

#1837 (for #1730) adds `_ConsumedTerminalModel`. It leaves an earlier `bee_done` report that a turn already answered out of the model input; the Store transcript does not change. In #1847's case the relay turn answers the report, so the next normal turn no longer sees `[Hive event: bee_done]`. The test looked for that report with `next(...)`, which raised the `StopIteration`.

## Decision

The #1837 behaviour is intended: a raw user-role report must not ask for a second relay. That projection stays as it is. The part that went stale is the #1847 `[normal] quick_note`. It said a result is delivered when "this conversation holds a [Hive event: bee_done] report followed by your reply relaying it". Since #1837 the report is never in the model input for an earlier relay.

## Change (prompt text, docs and test only; no wire, Store or Host change)

- `quick_reply.toml` `[normal] quick_note`: a result is delivered when one of Beebou's earlier replies relays it, or when `finished[]` shows it with `reported: true`. A new sentence says the report is left out once a turn has answered it.
- Contract `beebou-choice-card.md` C4 and `contracts/UPDATES.md` say the same.
- The Bridge test now checks what the normal turn really sees: the report is absent, the relay comes before the user's message, then the quick reply and the note. It also checks the new note wording.

## Validation (Linux build host, Python 3.13, server-engine wheel reinstalled from this branch)

- `test_hive_beebou_choice_card.py`: 18 passed (it failed 1 of 18 on main `0e6777f81`).
- hive-beebou tests: 167 passed. hive-runtime tests: 155 passed, 1 skipped.
- Architecture check (`tools/architecture/check.py` with the module-ownership policy): 0 findings.
- Bridge `tests/test_hive_*.py` on this branch compared with main: 580 passed and 9 failed on the branch; 579 passed and 10 failed on main `0e6777f81`. The only difference is this test. The 9 other failures (`test_hive_bee_unavailable_terminal` x6, `test_hive_document_model_reads` x2, `test_hive_bee_lifecycle` x1) and the `test_hive_activity_history` collection error (no `hive` module on the build host) are the same on both.

Refs #1907 #1784

## Problem
QA #1790 §12.7: in the same task, `./r4.pdf` was refused as `outside_workspace` while `r4.pdf` came back `not_found`. `Workspace.parts` refused every `.` and `..` component outright.

## Change
- `temp/hive-tools/src/dm_hive_tools/workspace.py`: `Workspace.parts` now normalizes lexically before the `O_NOFOLLOW` per-component walk. It drops `.` and empty components, and a `..` removes the component before it. So `./x`, `x`, `sub/../x` and `<root>/./x` all give the same parts, for every read and write tool and both relative and absolute paths. The parts are still opened one component at a time without following links.
- Still refused: a `..` above the root, an absolute path that is not under the root, symlinks at any level, and the receipts directory (outside every readable root, so any `..` route to it climbs above the root).
- `a file path is required` (for example `.` given to a file tool) is now classed as `outside_workspace`.
- `deliver_file`: the argument check leaves `.`/`..` to the workspace and still refuses absolute paths, backslashes and NUL.
- `skill_tool`: `..` must stay inside the named skill's own directory, so it cannot reach a sibling skill.

## Tests
- workspace: equivalence for read/stat/list (relative and absolute); `not_found` for `./r4.pdf`, `r4.pdf` and `docs/../r4.pdf`; `..` escapes, absolute escapes and link escapes still refused; extra receipts routes.
- read handlers: read_file, list_files, glob, read_pdf (Bee) and read (Beebou) with `./` and `sub/..`.
- write_exec: write_file/edit_file through `./r4.txt`, `sub/../r4.txt` and `docs/./x/../out.txt`. `./x.txt` moved from the refused list to the positive test, and `./../escape.txt` is refused.
- skills and deliver_file argument checks.

1909.author: Jun-Eric
1909.body: ## Summary Closes #1777 BeeBou/SVG replies could stay on either placeholder indefinitely: 1. **「图片生成中…」**: the placeholder was keyed to `row.streaming`. The task final event and the row's display animation are independent, so a row could still be `streaming` after the accepted reply was complete, and the visibility callback never started the SVG conversion. 2. **「图片加载中…」**: the 15s wait covered only the status polling loop. `runJavaScript`, screenshot, PNG write and PixelMap decode could each stall with no end-to-end deadline and no failure state. Long streamed SVGs also made the typewriter re-parse the animated prefix every tick. ## What changed - Add `DiagramRenderCoordinator` (`entry/.../DiagramRenderCoordinator.ets`): a page-owned queue with one 15s budget for queue wait + conversion, attempt tokens that fence stale callbacks, terminal failure reasons (`QUEUE_LIMIT`, `QUEUE_TIMEOUT`, `RENDER_TIMEOUT`, `ASSETS_UNAVAILABLE`, `JS_ERROR`, `DECODE_FAILED`, `PNG_WRITE_FAILED`, `SVG_XML_INVALID`) and a renderer reset on timeout. - `DigitalMateConversation.replySource(row)` exposes the accepted reply text and `complete` independently of the animated row, so pictures start as soon as the final text exists. - `CloudMarkdown` records each SVG block's original source range (LF and CRLF), and `ReplyMediaProjectionCache` caches projections by complete source so the reveal can skip hidden SVG ranges instead of re-parsing prefixes. - Page: the pending state now comes from accepted-source completeness; visible images are reconciled when the final arrives; failures become a retryable「图片暂时无法显示 / 重试加载」; PNG writes go to a staged file and are renamed, so a failed conversion cannot leave a corrupt cache; the hidden WebView is remounted per host generation. - `render.js`: recover only complete XML comments that violate the XML comment grammar when sanitising fails; fence old `mermaid.render` promises so they cannot overwrite a newer raw SVG or its error state. ## Test plan - [x] Focused regression tests (90): `diagram-render-coordinator`, `reply-media-source`, `svg-comment-normalization`, mermaid lazy-load, preview lifecycle, inline mermaid preview, stream presentation, topic async, svg artifact source. - [x] Combined related suite, including `gateway-cloud-ui` and suggestions: 186/186 pass. - [ ] Emulator/device check: reproduce「画一张路线示意图」and the deepseek-harness SVG request; record the time the task finishes, the placeholder transitions, and when the image or failure appears. - [ ] Attach before/after screenshots for both placeholder states. Two failures in the full local unit run are environment-only and unrelated: `ui-control-visual` needs the Playwright Chromium download, and `st-live-wire-chunks` expects dependency version `8.22.1` while the local install resolved `8.22.2`. ## Scope - Does not include the #1566 bubble/question-card changes, local signing configuration, or the follow-up inline `Next:` protocol-tail sanitizer (separate PR). - No public contracts, permissions, persisted formats or component ownership change.

1911.author: Jianyu010
1911.body:
## Summary

Fixes the intermittent B17 hang from QA #1790 §12.7. A Bee's nested `ask_user` in a resume turn sometimes reached the Host as `chat.ask_user_question` with `source: permission_interrupt`, header 权限审批 and an empty question. The Host recorded nothing and the task stayed `running`.

### Cause

Agent-core's `ask_user` interrupt (`AskUserRequest`) carries no text of its own. The card's question comes from the call's `query` or `questions` argument. If the model's resumed step calls `ask_user` without `query` (for example `{"question": "..."}`, or with empty or unparsable arguments), WorkSwarm's `convert_interactions_to_ask_user_question` finds no question text. The call then falls through to the permission branch, because `ask_user` is not one of the confirm tools. The adapter turns that into a `confirm` event. `BeeAnswerResume` only records `ask_user` events with question text, so it returned `None`: the answer delivery stayed pending and the Run stayed RUNNING.

The QA history shows the second call's interrupt with no question text, which only this path produces. It is intermittent because it depends on how the model writes that call's arguments.

### Fix

1. **At the source: the Bee tool rail** (`runtime_patches/hive_tool_rail.py`, our owned module; the imported WorkSwarm tree stays pristine). Before the interrupt rails run, an `ask_user` call with neither `query` nor `questions` is rewritten in place:
   - If an alias key (`question`/`prompt`/`text`/`message`/`content`) holds text, the call gets `query` from it. The question is recorded, the card shows and the task waits on the user.
   - With no question text at all, the call gets one empty structured question. WorkSwarm's own `ask_user` rail then refuses it back to the model with the shape to send (`questions[0].question is required …`) instead of interrupting.
2. **Host fallback** (`BeeAnswerResume`). A resume that still stops on a wait no card can show (a `confirm`, or a question without text) is handled like a Stop. The runtime wait is stopped with the confirmed `chat.interrupt` that Stop uses, and the resume returns a witnessed `UnrecordableWait`. The scheduler then ends the task failed with reason `question_unavailable` on the answer's own turn, which settles the delivery, and publishes the notice. An unconfirmed stop or a changed claim still returns `None`, as before.
3. **Client and contract.** `digitalmateHiveFailureText('question_unavailable')` has its own wording, which keeps 任务执行失败 for the e2e detector. The new reason is added to the reason list in `beebou-hive-phase3-delivery.md`.

## Verification

All runs were on the remote test host, on the patched WorkSwarm runtime built by `deploy/install_runtime.py` from main `2bd70fe8` plus this diff.

- **Repro on the real runtime, unfixed rail.** `test_hive_bee_lane_real.py::test_a_nested_ask_user_without_query_stays_a_question` fails on main's rail with `['confirm'] != ['ask_user']`. The nested event is `source: permission_interrupt`, header `权限审批: ask_user`, `tool_payload: {"question": "Which fruit?"}`.
- **With the fix, the same test passes.** The nested event is `ask_user` (`ask_user_interrupt`, question "Which fruit?"). Its answer reaches the model, the `{}` call is refused to the model (no interrupt), and the turn ends with an answer. The whole real-lane file passes (3 tests).
- **Product journey with the owned runtime** (`tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase2_cli_bee_question.py`, `WORKSWARM_RUNTIME_TESTS=1`). The new case `test_nested_question_without_query_is_still_a_question_card` passes: card shown, task `waiting_user`, answer consumed, final delivered. The original, B14 nested and B13 empty-reply journeys also pass.
- **`temp/hive-runtime/tests/test_hive_runtime_answer_unrecordable.py`** (new) passes:
  - a confirm, or a question without text, is stopped (abort once) and witnessed;
  - an unconfirmed stop or a changed claim gives `None`;
  - a recordable nested question is not stopped.

  `test_hive_runtime_answer_lane.py` and `test_hive_runtime_ask_user_timeout.py` also pass (14 in all).
- **`test_phase2_bee_scheduler.py::test_unrecordable_wait_after_the_answer_fails_the_task_and_publishes`** on the real Store: the task is `failed` with reason `question_unavailable`, the Run ended, no open question, published once.
- `tools/architecture/check.py`: clean.
- **Failures that are the same on unmodified main in that ad-hoc venv**, so they are environmental and not from this change:
  - `test_phase3_bee_empty_final.py` (5): "Bee effects must be configured before the Bee runtime starts";
  - `test_session_proximity_hosted_bindings.py::ActualRuntimeOriginProbeTests` (4): dependency inventory probe;
  - `test_phase2_cli_bee_question.py::test_native_home_question_answer_stays_in_original_evicted_bee_lane` (1): `no such table: dm_hive_document_withdrawals`.

  CI is the authority for these.
- **Not run yet:**
  - the HarmonyOS hypium suite for the client wording change (`HiveBeeTerminalHome.test.ets`), left to device CI;
  - the emulator run. This changes device behaviour, so an emulator run is required before merge.

接续前面的两个独立优化（基于 2026-11-13~17 的网速实测）：

## 1. gate-report 精简下载（前一个 commit）
只拉 `scripts/gate/*.mjs` + `.github/ci-gates.json`（~45KB），替代 203MB 全量 tarball。dm-utility 节点实测 0.7MB/s、4:59 贴着 300s 悬崖。

## 2. Windows runner 共享镜像去重（本 commit）
**问题**：同一台机器的两个 device runner 共享一个慢速出口。当晚高峰 4 路任务同时下载同一个 ~100-200MB 包时，每路被摊薄到 ~330KB/s，实测一单 5:36。

**方案**：`ProgramData\dsh\ci-mirrors` 机器级裸镜像 + 全局互斥锁：
- 首个任务 seed 一次浅克隆（~103MB pack）
- 后续任务只 fetch 想要的 SHA（增量，几 MB）+ `git archive` 物化文件树
- 任何失败自动回退原 tarball 路径，快路径永不破坏套件
- git 调用禁用 credential helper（wincredman 在服务上下文会故障），用内联 http.extraheader 认证

**真机端到端实测**（winbox，计划任务上下文）：
- 冷 seed 一次后，第二次完整运行（fetch+archive+解压）**14 秒**，文件树完整
- 对比负载下的 tarball 路径 91~342 秒，**快 6~24 倍**且几乎不占出口带宽
- 同机并发任务自动互斥排队，不再挤兑带宽

覆盖 hypium-ut（ci.yml）和 ST（pr-ready.yml）。

单测钉子已核对不破坏（ci-gate.test.mjs 的结构断言全部满足）。

1914.body: ## Summary Closes #1912 The runtime can append the suggestion protocol to the last prose line instead of starting a new line: ```text 如果需要，我可以把参与方换成你的实际模块名，或补充异常/重试子流程。Next: [{"label": "...", "ask": "...", "agent_id": "", "view": false, "ref": ""}] ``` The existing sanitizer only matched `Next:` at the start of a line, so this variant reached the Markdown view and the raw JSON was rendered in the reply bubble. A partially streamed `Next: [{"label"...` leaked the same way. ## What changed - `digitalmateReplyText` now also recognizes an inline `Next: [JSON]` that follows sentence-ending punctuation (`。！？.!?`, optionally followed by a quote or closing bracket), and removes only the protocol payload while keeping the preceding prose. - The inline match still requires a JSON array (`{`, `"` or `]` as the first payload character), so ordinary text such as `进度正常。Next: we ship Friday` stays untouched. - Partially streamed inline arrays (for example `正文。Next: [{"label":"列`) are hidden until the payload completes. - Fenced code blocks and blockquotes keep their existing behavior; user-authored messages are still never rewritten. ## Test plan - [x] `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-suggestions.test.mjs` — 18/18 pass. - [x] New fixtures: `inline-protocol-tail` (final and reconnect projection) and `inline-ordinary-next` (ordinary prose preserved). - [x] Streaming assertions cover `Next:`, `Next: [`, and an incomplete `Next: [{"label":"列`. - [x] Attach a before/after screenshot of the reply bubble. ## Scope - 3 files: `DigitalMateConversation.ets`, `tests/st/suggestions/fixtures.mjs`, `tests/unit/digitalmate-suggestions.test.mjs`. - No public contracts, permissions, persisted formats or component ownership change. - Follow-up to the earlier next-suggestion isolation fix, which only covered line-start protocol tails.

## Problem and change

Related to #1760; also fixes the stale-banner half reported against the merged #1858 line (#1408).

A Home attachment refused because intake is disabled, or because the format/combination is unsupported, used to surface `BAD_PARAMS` plus an English implementation sentence and then invite a retry that cannot succeed. The refusal now carries a stable `details.reason` (`home_attachments_disabled`, `home_attachment_format_unsupported`, `home_attachment_combination_unsupported`), and the composer answers with actionable Chinese guidance that points at the existing remove control and asks for a text description.

This replaces #1835, which conflicted with main after the broader non-PDF Home attachment admission landed. The rebase keeps main's wider admission (`hold_home_input` without the PDF-only rule) and keeps the PDF-only trial's own format refusal; permission failures, unknown receipts, auth errors and unrelated `BAD_PARAMS` are never reclassified as capability refusals.

Second, narrower fix from the 2026-11-17 06:28 device run: the rejected-attachment banner stayed on screen after the next reply had already rendered. That reply arrived from a notification snapshot, and the cached refresh branch returned before applying the clearing rule the network branch already applies. Both success paths now share `if (!this.uncertain) this.error = ''`, so a refusal cannot outlive the turn that owns it. The attachment itself stays in the composer with the existing × removal path; that is deliberate draft preservation, not a sent state.

## Validation

Base: `e02e99dffb1ff08943a35d4f0c3c5226503a721b`.

- PASS: `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-composer-send.test.mjs` — 88 tests, 88 passed. Covers the three structured refusal reasons, draft/attachment restoration, removal then text send, negative classification (FORBIDDEN and unknown reasons stay unclassified), unknown-receipt preservation, and the new cached-refresh clearing rule.
- NOT RUN locally: the bridge socket tests (`test_hive_home_trial.py`, `test_hive_home_input_pdf.py`). Local collection of `engine_connectors.registry` requires `telethon`, which this Windows checkout does not have. No shims or weakened assertions were used; CI's Linux runner is expected to execute them, and their assertions now cover the three reasons plus the FORBIDDEN-must-not-leak-a-reason case.
- PASS: `git diff --check`.
- NOT RUN: native ArkTS build, device screenshot, deployment.

## Scope

This is Chinese guidance plus the existing × exit, and the banner lifetime fix. It does not add OCR, cross-session forwarding, or any change to #1762's capability boundary.

## Problem and change

Refs #1895.

Beebou opened a normal greeting with “顺带一提：系统刚回收了「产品额度查询助手」来释放名额…”. The mechanism is the Host-injected `bee_evicted` notice (#1523): `eviction_notice_message()` prepends a label line plus the notice JSON into Beebou's context so the model knows a retired Bee cannot take work. That label already forbade dispatching to the retired id, but it never said the notice itself is internal, so the model paraphrased it back to the user as a system announcement.

The shipped `bee_evicted_label` now states the notice is internal routing bookkeeping:

- never announce the eviction, the freed slot or any capacity detail, and never open a reply with it;
- answer in plain product language only if the user asks about that Bee (no `bee_id`, slot or eviction terms).

The existing routing rule (“do not dispatch to it or activate it; read `list_bees` and create a new Bee with `reference_bee_id`”) is unchanged, so #1523's purpose survives: Beebou still learns the Bee is gone before it dispatches.

This picks the conservative half of the open #1895 decision — never surfaced proactively, conditional plain-language answer when asked. If the product owner prefers “never mention it at all”, dropping the final sentence is a one-line follow-up.

## Validation

Base: `954748bc872bad9f935dd3eb7dd5b2a571ab116a`.

- PASS: `tomllib` parses the shipped `hive_store.toml`; the label is still a single line (the loader rejects newlines) and still contains the dispatch/activation rule plus the new non-announcement rule.
- NOT RUN: `load_hive_settings()` and the Bridge tests. This checkout runs Python 3.11, and `hive_store.py` uses PEP 695 generics (`async def store_write[T]`), which 3.11 cannot parse. No shims or weakened assertions were used; CI's Python 3.13 runner is expected to execute the settings and Hive suites.
- NOT RUN: device/live acceptance — the change is a prompt label, so only a real turn can show the new wording behaviour.

## Scope

One shipped config label. No schema, state, dispatch or ownership change; no client change.

1922.author: huben0423-hw
1922.body:
## What this adds

A design draft for #1767: **Beebou's reply stays a whole turn, the Bee's run streams to the client.**

Today the quick reply and the normal turn are deliberately non-streaming (`stream=False`; one `{role, content}` committed per turn), and that is kept. The gap is the Bee lane: a Bee run can take minutes, and its text reaches the client only as a terminal notice, so a long run looks like a blank wait.

The draft proposes:

- an explicit `digitalmate.task.delta` frame (task_ref, run_id, seq, text, at) rather than reusing `digitalmate.task.text` with `final: false`, because the existing non-final path is bound to `snapshot.tasks`, which Hive tasks are deliberately not;
- a coalescing producer on the owned Bee launcher, which already streams from the runtime (`bee_runtime.stream_bound_bee`);
- an ephemeral client draft inside the Bee's own lane, replaced by the terminal, bounded (32 KiB) and never persisted;
- the failure branches (unknown task, out-of-order, stop, reconnect, terminal without deltas) and six acceptance cases (S1–S6).

## What this does not do

No code. No wire, Store, Host or persistence change. Design review is not completed, and nothing here authorizes implementation — the four open owner decisions are listed as questions, not assumptions: which surface shows deltas, the coalescing interval and buffer cap, backgrounding behaviour, and whether a new event name is acceptable.

## Validation

- Docs-only. `git diff --check` clean; no test is claimed.
- The file paths and behaviour claims were read from the current main: `server_engine/hive_turn_startup.py:285`, `session_proximity/models.py:86`, `temp/hive-runtime/src/dm_hive_runtime/assembly/bee_runtime.py:123`, and the client's `digitalmate.task.text` handling in `DigitalMateConversation.ets`.

1927.author: haowenz001
1927.body:
接续已合并的 #1913（gate-report 精简下载）。本 PR 解决 Windows device runner 的源码下载挤兑问题。

## 问题

同一台 Windows 机器的两个 device runner（winbox: st-01/st-04，winbox2: st-02/st-03）共享一个慢速出口。晚高峰 4 路任务同时下载同一个 ~100-200MB tarball 时，每路被摊薄到 ~330KB/s，实测一单 hypium-ut 下载耗时 5:36（2026-11-17 实测，st-01）。

## 方案：机器级共享裸镜像 + 全局互斥锁

`ProgramData\dsh\ci-mirrors` 下每仓库一个裸镜像：
- 首个任务持锁 seed 一次 `--depth 1` 裸克隆（实测 ~103MB pack）
- 后续任务持锁 `fetch --depth 1 <sha>`（增量，几 MB）→ `git archive` 物化文件树
- 同机并发任务互斥排队——不再重复下载同一个包，也不互相挤兑带宽
- 任何失败（锁、clone、fetch、archive、解压）自动回退原 tarball 路径，快路径永不破坏套件
- git 调用禁用 credential helper（wincredman 在服务上下文会故障），用内联 `http.extraheader` 认证，token 不落盘

## 真机端到端实测（winbox，计划任务上下文）

| 场景 | 耗时 |
|---|---|
| 冷启动 seed 一次 | ~103MB（一次性）|
| 第二次完整运行（fetch+archive+解压） | **14 秒** |
| 现网 tarball 路径（负载下） | 91~342 秒 |

覆盖 hypium-ut（ci.yml）和 ST（pr-ready.yml）两个下载步骤；结构单测钉子已核对不破坏。

## 紧急修复

#1913 合并的 gate script fetch 依赖 **jq**，但 dm-utility 云池节点没装 jq——**main 上现在每个 PR 的 gate-report 都会红**（3 次 `jq: command not found` 后失败）。实测：#1927 的 CI run 里 gate-report 三次尝试全部失败于此。

## 修复

改用 runner 预装的工具链：
- `gh api`（同 workflow 其他步骤也在用）拉取文件内容（raw media type）与目录树

## 背景

Closes #1138：Hive（Beebou→Bee）链路下，一轮回复失败时气泡只有通用提示（“抱歉，这条消息没能处理完成…”），
无法区分 401/429/超时，也没有可供用户上报的 trace。

根因：失败结算时 cause 和 trace 只写进了模型上下文头的诊断副本，
Hive Home 记录里只有 notice，客户端渲染的投影行拿不到结构化失败信息。

## 改动

### 服务端（customization harness / dm_hive_beebou）

- `hive_store.py`
  - 新增 `beebou_failure_code(kind, reason)`：把模型失败的 reason 归类为 `auth` / `rate` / `timeout` / `model`，非模型失败返回空串。
  - `BeebouHomeSubmission` 新增 `failure_code`、`failure_trace_id`，从 `dm_hive_beebou_turn_failures` 的 `kind/reason/trace_id` 读出。
  - `_HOME_SUBMISSIONS` 两个 UNION 分支补齐对应列。
- `home_projection.py`
  - 失败回复行附加 `provenance.trace_id`（所有已结算失败）和 `provenance.failure_code`（仅模型类失败）。
  - 非模型失败（effect/capacity/harness/interrupted 等）保留原有 notice 文案——它们本身有可操作建议——同时获得 trace/复制句柄。
- `hive_turn_startup.py`
  - 失败的 `reply_frame` 携带 `failure_code`、`trace_id`；失败的 `send_message` 结果返回 `trace_id`。

### 客户端

- `DigitalMateConversation.ets`：识别 `hive-home:` 前缀且带 `provenance.trace_id` 的 result 行，按 cause 输出失败文案（401/429/超时/模型不可用），保留原有 bridge / task 失败路径不变。
- `DigitalMateProtocol.ets`：事件补充 `failure_code`、`trace_id`。
- `Index.ets`：
  - 气泡显示原因句 + 「复制诊断信息」，trace 不在气泡上展示，只进复制内容；
  - 复制内容包含 `时间 / 说明 / trace / task`；
  - 修正复制诊断的时间格式（聊天行时间戳单位是秒，之前按毫秒格式化显示成 1970 年）。

## 范围边界

Bee 任务自身终态失败（`bee_terminal`，#1678）是另一套行结构和文案，`dm_hive_failed_results` 也不存 trace，本次不改。

## 验证

- Node：`node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-failed-reply-retention.test.mjs` 14/14 通过（含 Hive auth 原因句、无 cause 时保留 notice、trace 透出）。
- pytest：`test_hive_beebou_failed_turn`、`test_hive_failure_cause` 共 40 通过；`test_hive_home_trial` 20 通过；relay/choice/unavailable-terminal 27 通过；`dm_hive_beebou` 投影单测 14 通过。
- 镜像 `v2026111711-adx-jiuwen-test-2`（提交 48372b362）北京/香港双仓校验通过。
- 真机（无效 API_KEY 触发 401）：气泡显示“云端模型凭据已失效…”，点「复制诊断信息」得到 16 位 hex trace；修正时间格式后复验时间显示正常。

## 无破坏性变更

协议字段均为可选新增；原有非 Hive 失败路径与 `bee_terminal` 行为不变。

## What this adds

Relates to #1646 (does not close it — the issue tracks the full discovery feature; this is its bounded first slice behind a pilot switch).

With `bee_effects.toml [discovery] enabled`, the Host-owned Bee effect gate answers `mcp_<server>_discover_tools` itself:

- a read-only listing of the hive-tools catalog's Host-listed Bee tools for the bound Run (`bee && enabled && bee_listing == "host" && !forbidden`), with an optional case-insensitive `query` on name/description and a `limit` (default 20, clamped 1–50);
- descriptions come from the tool handlers (`dm_hive_tools.handlers.load_handlers`), truncated to 240 chars, sorted by name;
- the listing is recomputed at call time, so it always matches what the Host could grant; the same Run/generation/Session-binding re-check as an effect call applies, and a discovered tool still needs its own grant at call time — nothing is journaled and no provider runs;
- off by default: the tool name is then absent from `runtime_names()`, so the existing "not allowlisted" refusal answers it.

The MCP listing server advertises `discover_tools` when the switch is on (execution still refused there, as for every advertised tool), and the Bridge socket env carries the flag so the server can see it.

## Resolved-with-defaults decisions (reversible)

- Pilot granularity: per-deployment opt-in inside effects mode; rollback is `enabled = false`.
- In-flight Runs: unaffected — the call is read-only and re-checks the binding at call time.
- Interface owner: the existing Host effect gate, reusing the read-branch answer shape (`{"status": "read"}`).

## Validation

- `temp/hive-runtime/tests/test_bee_tool_discovery.py` — **12 passed, 12 subtests passed** (Python 3.11.15 venv, PYTHONPATH `temp/hive-runtime/src` + `temp/hive-tools/src`). Covers: disabled → refused as not allowlisted; enabled → only bee+enabled+host-listed non-forbidden tools; runtime-listed/disabled/non-bee/forbidden rows excluded; query filter; limit cap/clamp; `record_bee_effect` never called; provider apply never called; binding-mismatch and no-lane refusals; ImportError → `unavailable_on_host`; invalid argument types → `invalid_arguments`; settings load errors.
- Neighbour `test_bee_effects.py` — all pass.
- `test_hive_runtime_deploy_settings.py::test_deployment_toml_refusals` fails identically on the pristine base (Windows CRLF at-limit case) — pre-existing, unrelated.
- Bridge module tests — NOT RUN in this venv (`temp/beebou` delivery uses PEP 695, unparseable on Python 3.11); the changed bridge modules were smoke-tested directly (`build_server` on/off, socket env JSON) — behaviour correct. CI's Python 3.13 runner will execute the bridge suites.
- `git diff --check` — pass.

No device tests, no live Hive Host run. The switch is off by default, so no deployment is affected until it opts in.

1946.author: Jianyu010
1946.body:
Bridge shutdown can release workspace authority while the Store is still open. When the Store close phase runs past the shutdown deadline, `_shutdown_phase` cancels `engine.close`. A cancelled task is `done()`, so the phase reported success. `authority.close()` then raised `LegacyAdmissionFlowError: Workspace stores must close successfully before authority release` instead of the expected shutdown `ExceptionGroup`.

This is the timing failure seen in the full local Bridge regression for #1926 (`BridgeShutdownTest::test_hung_producer_does_not_prevent_task_cancellation`). Under load, the Store close exceeds the test's 0.1 s grace. The same failure happens on main whenever `engine.close` is slow, so it is not specific to #1926.

Change: `_shutdown_phase(..., complete=True)` for the Store/delivery/host phase and the harness phase. A close that had to be cancelled now counts as unsettled. Authority stays held, and the timeout is reported in the `ExceptionGroup`. Producer, execution and backend phases keep their current behaviour.

Validation (local, Python 3.13.13, Bridge installed as a non-editable package):
- New `test_store_close_cancelled_at_deadline_retains_authority` delays `engine.close` past the deadline. It fails on main with the `LegacyAdmissionFlowError` above and passes with this change.
- The existing delayed-stop subtest for `test_hung_producer_does_not_prevent_task_cancellation` fails on main with the same error and passes with this change.
- `test_bridge_shutdown.py`: 16 passed, 3 failed. All 3 also fail on main and are unrelated to this change: `test_desktop_transfer_is_rejected_before_local_changes` (`Bridge.transfers` missing), `test_stop_rejects_requests_and_runs_cleanup_once` (`dispatch_guest` missing), and `test_stop_cancels_startup_before_producers_start` (timeout).

No Store schema, protocol or client change.

- `test_engine_connectors_events::test_missing_swarm_package_reports_cleanly` and `test_engine_connectors_registry::test_build_returns_provider_connectors_with_their_secrets`: the vendored runtime installs `jiuwenswarm` in the venv, so "jiuwenswarm not installed" was never true. ## 问题

自 2026-11-13 晚的 nightly 起，device ST 三条 lane 全部死在 'compile independent test HAP'（启动约 10 秒、21 个 ArkTS 错误），从未跑到用例。真实报错在 CI 上不可见：Windows harness 把编译器输出写进 execution-error.txt，而制品上传被 Actions 存储配额挡住（#1710）。

## 根因

Beebou/Hive 客户端工作（#1243、#1644）带来两类破坏：

1. `DigitalMateWireRequest.params` 联合类型被拓宽（DigitalMateHiveParams / HiveNamedTextRequest / HiveChoiceSendRequest / HiveActivityParams）。四个 ObservedSocket（Artifact/Identity/Downlink/Compatibility）按严格联合类型解码 wire JSON 并直接访问 action / room_id / task_id / artifact_id / submission_id / text —— 17 个编译错误。
2. 抽取的生产方法引用了 ST 宿主没有的新成员：send 之后的 signalHiveActivity、attach 等处的 drainAttachmentCleanup、submitPendingAnswer 里的 submitHiveAnswer 与 DIGITALMATE_HIVE_QUESTION_PREFIX 常量。

## 修复

- 四个 ObservedSocket 改为本地结构化接口（ObservedWireParams 可选字段）解码 —— 观测器不再被客户端严格联合类型门禁，对未来联合类型拓宽免疫；
- ComposerHost 供给新成员：signalHiveActivity 无操作（ST 无 Hive 面板，与 e4aedb190 的意图一致）、drainAttachmentCleanup 异步无操作（ST 无清理存储）、submitHiveAnswer 显式 throw（未覆盖面宁可响亮失败）；
- DigitalMateHiveCards 进入拷贝清单并从生成 index 再导出，常量来自真实客户端模块而非复制粘贴；
- SessionProximity 的 ScriptedTransport 用 as DigitalMateRequest 显式收窄（它只记录普通请求）。

## 验证

- `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-device-st.test.mjs`：36/36（含拷贝清单 import 走查守卫）
- `node --test tests/unit/st-live-wire*.test.mjs`：44/44
- `ST_SUITE=compile-only`：business ✅ / session-proximity ✅ / attachment-policy ✅（回归）
- 修复前基线：business 套件 21 个编译错误（本地 /tmp/dm-st-repro-*/build.log）
